name: @red-cup-engineering/semiotic-voxel-arena-service
description: Active-only admission law for one canonical-RMN-identified network semiotic atom; no voxel persistence.

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm pack --dry-run

x-semiotic-voxel.projection: Package/deployment projection metadata only; never a network atom or boundary carrier.

boundary-semantics.atom: The canonical-RMN-identified network causal-event record; not an Obsmetrologia Mark, Utterance, or Cell.
boundary-semantics.voxel: Active reconstruction only; never persisted and never crossed over the boundary.
boundary-semantics.identity: The atom id names canonical typed RMN commitment bytes; this package defines neither an Utterance-plus-locus carrier body nor a resolver.
